# Locksmith Kit
<!-- generated by tools/wiki_tables.py, do not edit -->

![Locksmith Kit](images/items/1210_briefcase.png)

*Use this on the driver-side of a vehicle with \[F\] to install a new lock and make a key to secure the vehicle.*

|:--|:--|
| Size | 3 |

## Where to find it

Not found as loot.

- Crafted, see below.

## Crafting

**Made by**

- At a [Workbench](Workbench) with a [Screwdriver](Screwdriver) (kept): [Key](Key) + [Motor](Motor)

**Used in**

- [Lock and Chain](Lock-and-Chain) (1 used up)
- [Electronic Lockpick](Electronic-Lockpick) (1 used up)

## Scrap

Worth 2 [Scrap Metal](Scrap-Metal) in a Scrap Machine, see [Scrap](Scrap).
